notes: Solid run on substance: every behavior is covered, invariants are respected without being cited by number, and the questions.md is the best part of the output. The two fails are TKT-014 at four sentences and the overdue intro paragraph leading with 'Overdue is a condition, not a state' instead of what the agent gets. Eval-wise, assertions 2, 3 and 11 are phrased for a new spec file but the fixture's docs/README.md pushes toward amending, so the amend path needs its own wording (does the inline Assumed marker count as a sentence; which paragraph is 'the intro').
